invariants.rationale: The method dereferences 'map' multiple times, so it cannot be null at this point.
The method accesses 'map.getProperties()' many times, so it must be non-null.
The method checks 'map.getLayers().size()' and gets element 0, so layers must be non-null.
At least one of these values must be present or layers must not be empty for hexSideLength assignment.
The method reads 'height' property to determine stagger index, so it must be present for that logic to execute.
